executed.scope: Fresh two-cutoff direct evolution; four Volterra grids; Rabi and complex-rank-two controls; three reservoir reductions with full outgoing-residual estimates.
Full unregulated integer recurrence through amplitude order 11; independent event predicate; exact first-return norm identity.

limitations: Analytic Duhamel upper sums evaluated in ordinary floating point, not outward-rounded intervals. The Volterra discretization is checked by convergence and direct comparison, not certified by a rigorous quadrature bound. Reservoir bounds include full outgoing electric residuals.
